2390-3966-6125.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-6125.description:
Gain life.
Fiendish Panda triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7278-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7278-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5254-6774-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6774-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

728-2018-6288.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2781-2947-3899.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

618-6966-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

240-3899-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

872-5233-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

2781-6867-6967-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a slumber counter on it and without summoning sickness

1909-3201-4486.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Arixmethes.
Repeat.

1651-3715-5365-7315.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-7315.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

4365-4659-5346-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of it due to Mondrak.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

821-2173-5220-7192.description:
Cast Mogg Fanatic by paying its mana cost.
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3991-5147-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1286-5972-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-5972-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

478-804-2821-3007-6745.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3007-6745.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
478-804-2821-3007-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
478-804-2821-3007-6745.description:
Animate Candelabra using Toymaker.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

252-2073-3967--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2781-5399.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Pirated Copy.
2781-5399.description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Pirated Copy enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Pirated Copy. Choose to have Pirated Copy enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

145-2196-2821-5803.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two enchantments.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
145-2196-2821-5803.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum and another land by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Serra's Sanctum and another land.
Activate Serra's Sanctum and another land by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.
145-2196-2821-5803.notes: If you control three or more enchantments, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

2060-2092-2313-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-2313-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

851-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2438-3621-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard tokens.

409-3617-4211.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Deadbridge Chant triggers, returning Time Walk to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can fail if other cards enter your graveyard after step 1.

239-2713-3099-3767.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
239-2713-3099-3767.description:
Activate any Sliver by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate the tapped Sliver by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

1849-2068-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
1849-2068-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping and sacrificing it and another nontoken creature you control, targeting any applicable creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Whisper.
Resolve both Whisper abilities, returning Whisper and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2557-3649-3851-4600-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Etrata.
Etrata does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent owns at least two cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Each opponent controls at least three nontoken creatures, minus one for each card they own in exile with a hit counter on it.
2557-3649-3851-4600-4772.description:
Declare Etrata as an attacker, attacking an opponent that owns at least two cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Etrata's myriad ability triggers, creating four copies of it attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with each Etrata, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first Etrata ability, causing the opponent dealt damage by it to exile a creature they control with a hit counter on it, and lose the game if they have at least three cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Repeat step 4  for each remaining trigger.

202-2498.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
202-2498.description:
Draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards due to Lich.
Repeat step 2.

122-2324-5170-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver.
Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Phyrexian Delver's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
Proper Burial and Junji trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Junji's toughness.
Resolve the Junji trigger, causing you to lose 2 life and to put Phyrexian Delver from your graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, causing you to return Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose five life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4, causing target player to mill cards equal to Junji's power.
Repeat.

224-872-3257.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.
